description: Lexical cases every decoder of the envelope agrees on (the server codec and the phone's decodeEnvelope; both test suites read this file). bareValues: a value written without quotes inside an open object (skill.call.args, skill.result.output, a skill.manifest.skills[] item) must be true, false, null or a number of RFC 8259; refused ones are invalid JSON, a number with a fraction or exponent must be finite (1e999 is refused, 1e-999 is not) and an integer literal may have at most integerDigits digits (the sign does not count). stringCharacters: code points that appear raw (not escaped) inside a string; every one below U+0020 is refused. escapes: backslash sequences inside a string, given as the text between the quotes. whitespace: code points between tokens; only the four of JSON are accepted. Nesting (35 open brackets, 36 refused) is built by the tests.
